note: Reviewed town corrections to residential land (plan stage F). Applied by js/estimator.js. Changed only by merging a calibration pull request opened by the monthly comparables workflow (market-scan/comparables/calibrate.js).

LIPA CITY.basis: median of project medians of bank/Pag-IBIG lot price x 1.1 / guide land, shrunk by 0.286, from 1

houseSize.note: House-size grade on the construction rate, from bank and Pag-IBIG house prices (market-scan/comparables/fit-model.js). Applied by js/estimator.js houseSizeGrade: the rate for a floor-area band is the config rate x factor, blended across band boundaries. Changed only by merging a pull request opened by the monthly comparables workflow.
houseSize.basis: median per development of (price x 1.10 - guide land) / guide building, then the median across developments, shrunk by developments / (developments + 5) toward 1, capped 0.3-2.5

range.note: Measured range by segment, from bank and Pag-IBIG prices (market-scan/comparables/fit-model.js). Applied by js/estimator.js rangeFactors to houses and lots on residential land; everything else keeps the 85%-130% planning scenarios. Changed only by merging a pull request opened by the monthly comparables workflow.
range.basis: 16th to 84th percentile across developments of the median (price x 1.10 / guide) per development, with the house-size grade in force; one development counts once
